user.title: Set up Nursery Soother
user.description: Select the nursery devices, local audio for each soothing level, and at least one Home Assistant Companion App notification action.

data_description.baseline_sound: Choose local audio to play at Baseline.
data_description.level_1_sound: Choose local audio to play at Level 1.
data_description.level_2_sound: Choose local audio to play at Level 2.
data_description.level_3_sound: Choose local audio to play at Level 3.
data_description.level_4_sound: Choose local audio to play at Level 4.
data_description.notify_targets: Enter one or more registered actions such as notify.mobile_app_parent_phone.

behavior.title: Configure soothing behavior
behavior.description: Choose conservative level volumes and cry-evidence timings. Nursery Soother starts in Standby with automatic operation off.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Nursery Soother
reconfigure.description: Update the nursery devices, per-level soothing audio, or parent notification actions.

data_description.baseline_sound: Choose local audio to play at Baseline.
data_description.level_1_sound: Choose local audio to play at Level 1.
data_description.level_2_sound: Choose local audio to play at Level 2.
data_description.level_3_sound: Choose local audio to play at Level 3.
data_description.level_4_sound: Choose local audio to play at Level 4.
data_description.notify_targets: Enter one or more registered actions such as notify.mobile_app_parent_phone.

abort.devices_already_configured: One or more selected nursery devices were assigned to another entry while setup was in progress. Start setup again with different devices.

error.invalid_entity: The selected entity does not exist.
error.invalid_entity_domain: The selected entity has the wrong type.
error.entity_already_configured: This entity is already assigned to another Nursery Soother entry.
error.unsupported_media_player: The selected media player must support playing media, setting its volume, and stopping or pausing playback.
error.notify_targets_required: Select at least one parent notification action.
error.invalid_notify_action: Each notification action must use the format notify.mobile_app_device_name.
error.invalid_audio_media: Select an audio item for soothing playback.
error.invalid_local_audio_media: Select soothing audio from Home Assistant's My media library.
error.notify_action_not_found: One or more notification actions are not registered in Home Assistant.
error.invalid_volume_configuration: Volumes must increase monotonically from Baseline through Level 4 and remain at or below Maximum.
error.positive_integer_required: Enter a whole number of seconds greater than zero.

init.title: Configure soothing behavior
init.description: Update level volumes and cry-evidence timings. This does not change the current level or operating mode.

error.invalid_volume_configuration: Volumes must increase monotonically from Baseline through Level 4 and remain at or below Maximum.

invalid_entity.message: The configured {config_key} must be a valid entity ID.

invalid_entity_domain.message: The configured {config_key} must be a {expected_domain} entity.

invalid_options.message: The stored level, volume, or timer settings are invalid. Reconfigure Nursery Soother.

invalid_configuration.message: The stored soothing media or parent notification configuration is invalid. Reconfigure Nursery Soother.

duplicate_devices.message: One or more nursery devices are already assigned to another Nursery Soother entry. Reconfigure this entry with different devices.

not_configured.message: Nursery Soother needs soothing audio and at least one parent notification action before it can start.

not_loaded.message: Nursery Soother is not loaded. Reload its config entry before using this control.

invalid_volume.message: Volumes must increase monotonically from Baseline through Level 4 and remain at or below Maximum.

standby.message: Nursery Soother is in Standby. Select an active level first.

devices_unavailable.message: One or more configured nursery devices are unavailable.

playback_replaced.message: The nursery speaker is active outside this soothing session. Select an active level to explicitly start Nursery Soother again.

playback_settling.message: Home Assistant is still waiting for a previous speaker command to settle. Try selecting an active level again in a few seconds.

level_change_failed.message: The nursery speaker could not apply the selected soothing level. Check the speaker and try again.
